intro.tagline: Read the Bible in your terminal.
intro.subtitle: free · open source · pure Python

features.title: Navigate
features.description: Move through books, chapters, and verses with the arrow keys, or with Vim keys if you know them.
features.caption: Arrows or Vim keys, your choice.
bullets: Bible order or A to Z

features.title: Search
features.description: Find every verse that mentions a word, with a live match count as you type.
features.caption: Live matches as you type.
bullets: / to search, n and N to jump

features.title: Fuzzy find
features.description: Search the whole Bible at once, even when you only half remember the words.
features.caption: The whole Bible, half-remembered words.
bullets: Typos and missing spaces are fine

features.title: Go to any verse
features.description: Type a reference like John 3:16 and get there, with suggestions as you type.
features.caption: Type a reference, Tab to complete.

features.title: Side by side
features.description: Open two versions next to each other. They stay on the same verse as you read.
features.caption: Two versions, one verse.
bullets: Split side by side or top and bottom
Missing verses line up and show as gaps

features.title: Marks
features.description: Bookmark the verses you want to come back to, and jump to them from a list.
features.caption: Bookmark verses, jump back anytime.
bullets: m to mark, M to list

features.title: Highlights
features.description: Color verses in six soft highlights, and find them all again later.
features.caption: Six colors, saved for every version.

features.title: Copy verses
features.description: Copy a phrase, a verse, or a whole passage to paste anywhere, with the reference if you like.
features.caption: Paste scripture anywhere.
bullets: Your own format with the reference

outro.heading: Install bible-tui
outro.footnote: MIT licensed · KJV and ASV included
